## Changes

Summarize the feature or issue addressed and link the related issue.

## Verification

List the checks performed, their results, and environments that remain unverified. For changes involving the VS Code UI, WSL, or real USB devices, describe the actual evidence separately.

## Data review

- [ ] No third-party executables, real USB reports, device serial numbers, host names, private logs, or VSIX files were added.
- [ ] Documentation and test fixtures contain only information suitable for public release.
